result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but there is a spelling error in the search placeholder, an inconsistent favorite-button style between the two 'Popular right now' cards, and a mismatched thumbnail background in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and add spell-check to UI copy.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circle with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart. This inconsistency makes the second one look like a different state or a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button treatment (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards, reserving color changes only for the active/favorited state.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light gray background while the neighbouring Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria thumbnails have dark backgrounds, so the row looks visually uneven and the white time badge has weak contrast against the light image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail backgrounds (or apply a consistent gradient/scrim behind badges) so all carousel images share the same visual weight and badge contrast.
